claim: The sample opens with seven foods, three placed meals, and three targets.
where: landing sample action, README, demo documentation
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; assert visible food, meal, and target rows

claim: The sample week totals 40 g fibre and 75.5 g protein.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert landing totals and calculated /?demo=1 totals match

claim: The sample displays 40 g fibre above a 30 g floor and 75.5 g protein above a 75 g floor.
where: landing sample preview, README claims list
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert both target labels, floor values, calculated totals, pass classes, on-plan text, and accessible meter names

claim: Free to use with no payment gate.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /plan; add more than eleven foods and assert no price, checkout, license, or payment gate appears

claim: The planner uses no analytics and sends no meal data elsewhere.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; record every request while adding a food and require only same-origin requests

claim: The planner and demo work offline after setup.
sandbox: fresh browser context; set up service worker online, then reload and open an edit dialog on both /demo and /plan while offline

claim: Exports and reimports the complete plan as JSON.
where: planner toolbar, privacy page, README Data and privacy, README claims list
sandbox: fresh browser context; export the sample, import it into /plan, re-export it, and deep-compare foods, nutrient values, sources, targets, meals, portions, days, and timestamps

claim: Foods, targets, and meal portions stay in browser storage on your device.
where: landing facts, privacy page, README Data and privacy, README claims list
sandbox: fresh browser context at /plan; save a food with values and source, a target, and a meal portion; reload and assert every value and relationship

claim: Demo changes stay only in the open tab and reset on reload or exit.
where: demo banner, privacy page, README, demo documentation
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; add a food, reload, hard-navigate away, then close and reopen a tab; each new demo has the seven-food sample

claim: Reset demo restores the bundled sample without changing the real plan.
sandbox: save real data, change /?demo=1, reset it, and assert the seven-food sample returns while real data remains

where: planner target heading and capacity notice, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /plan; save five targets through the form, then attempt a sixth
fresh browser context at /demo; assert the browser print action is invoked

claim: Food values are entered by you and saved with a source.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /plan; save a numeric food value and source, then assert both are shown

claim: The planner compares entered food values with floors and limits you choose, including short, on-plan, within-limit, and over-limit states.
where: landing steps and explanation, planner guidance, terms page, README introduction, README How totals work, README claims list, catalog description
sandbox: fresh browser context at /plan; create floors and limits through the UI, add a food and meal, then assert short, on-plan, within-limit, and over-limit results with accessible meter names

claim: The planner does not supply recommended target values.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /plan; open the first target form and assert the target value is blank and no recommendation is shown

claim: You can plan meals without entering calories.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /plan; save a food, target, and meal using only the supported nutrient fields, and assert no calorie input exists

where: README Run checks and claims list
sandbox: clean checkout; Playwright web server runs npm run build before the test; assert dist/index.html is a complete app shell
